pages.title: A second book
pages.text: All I learned about the Beyond would not fit in this diary. So I made a second book: the $(thing)Bestiary of the Beyond$().$(br2)It holds the biomes, their plants and trees, the creatures and how to tame them, and the $(l:beyond/heralds)Heralds$(/l) with advice on defeating them.

pages.title: Bestiary
pages.text: Gunpowder, rotten flesh, a bone and a spider eye around an ordinary book: everything left of my world.
